title: Apply metadata pruning before vector ranking in hybrid retrieval
summary: For the current hybrid stack, prune by scope metadata before vector rank to prevent irrelevant candidates from affecting score fusion.
action: Filter candidate pools by project scope and transfer class before issuing vector ranking queries.
prerequisites: Each record has trusted scope metadata
The retrieval adapter exposes a pre-ranking filter hook
steps: Classify the request scope and allowed transfer boundaries
Reject unauthorized layers or projects at planning time
Issue backend queries only against the permitted candidate pool
Rank and fuse the remaining candidates
fallbacks: If pre-ranking filters are unavailable, return a degraded-mode warning and use exact metadata filtering after lexical retrieval only
Escalate to evidence-only audit mode if scope metadata is incomplete
rollback: Revert to exact metadata retrieval while the adapter is repaired
